ACM.description: “We will be a team of devils. Our colours will be red like fire and black to invoke fear in our opponents!” These were the words that Herbert Kilpin used as he founded AC Milan on 16 December 1899. AC Milan is one of the most successful football clubs of all time with over 40 titles to their name including 7 UEFA Champions Leagues and 18 Serie A titles.
ACM.name: AC Milan

AFC.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
AFC.description: Arsenal Football Club is a professional football club based in London, England. The club was born when a group of workers at Dial Square armaments factory in Woolwich, notably exiled Scotsman David Danskin and Jack Humble, decided to form a football team to break the monotony of factory life. Since that Dial Square team played its first match against Eastern Wanderers in 1886, Arsenal has gone on to become one of London’s most successful football clubs and one of the most famous names in modern football with millions of passionate followers worldwide. Steeped in history and tradition, Arsenal Football Club has thrived on a pioneering and innovative spirit that has existed throughout its 135 years in existence. While society and football may have changed during this time, Arsenal has always served to create a sense of community for people in north London, across the UK and around the world.
AFC.name: Arsenal

ALA.description: Alanyaspor was founded in the Alanya district on the Mediterranean coast of Turkey in 1948. Since their promotion to the Turkish Süper Lig in 2016 for the first time since being founded, the orange-greens continue to compete in Turkey's top league. Alanyaspor play their home matches in Bahçeşehir Okulları Stadium.
ALA.name: Alanyaspor

ALL.description: Alliance is a world-renowned esports organisation fielding competitive players across some of the most popular video games in the world. Shortly after Alliance’s inception, their Dota 2 team, headed by Jonathan ’Loda’ Berg, catapulted to the top of the scene with an innovative playstyle and went on to claim the Aegis of Champions when they won The International 2013. Alliance’s mission is to create a lasting legacy that supports esports experiences across the globe.
ALL.name: Team Alliance

ALPINE.description:
BWT Alpine F1 Team competes in the FIA Formula One World Championship with Grand Prix winner Esteban Ocon and two-time World Champion Fernando Alonso. Alpine is the French sports car brand founded in 1955 by Jean Rédélé and is today Renault Group’s dedicated brand for innovative, authentic and exclusive sports cars. A wider Business Unit allows Alpine to benefit from the heritage and know-how of its historic Dieppe factory and the engineering expertise of BWT Alpine F1 Team, Alpine Racing and Alpine Cars teams.
The Alpine F1 Team Fan Token (ALPINE) is a native BEP-20 utility token designed to revolutionize the fan experience for all BWT Alpine F1 Team supporters. The token empowers fans to engage with the team in multiple ways. Users can influence team decisions through exclusive voting rights, access digital collectibles and NFTs, and enjoy gamification features that are tied with special fan rewards and real-life experiences.
The ALPINE token is built and issued on the Binance Smart Chain (BSC), empowering BWT Alpine F1 Team fans with broader accessibility, more functionalities, and lower transaction costs. BSC is a Proof-of-Staked-Authority (PoSA) mainchain developed to run in parallel to the Binance Chain (BC) and it supports a major amount of token ecosystems based on it.
ALPINE.name: Alpine F1® Team

AM.description: Aston Martin Cognizant F1 Team is a British Formula One Team. Previously known as BWT Racing Point F1 Team, their last race victory came in the Grand Prix of Sakhir 2020, their first as a team since 2003 when they were known as Jordan. Powered by a Mercedes engine, the drivers this year are four-time World Champion Sebastian Vettel & promising Canadian driver Lance Stroll.
AM.name: Aston Martin Cognizant

APL.description: Apollon FC are one of the most successful Cypriot teams of all time, having won the Championship title on 3 occasions, the domestic cup 9 times and the Cypriot Super Cup 3 times. The club has also progressed to the Group Stages of the Europa League 4 times.
APL.name: Apollon Limassol

ARG.description: The Argentinian National Team, known as the Albiceleste, has won over 50 major international tournaments, including two FIFA World Cups. Its most recent achievement was beating Brazil in the 2021 Copa America final played at the iconic Maracanã stadium to win their 15th title, tying with Uruguay as the country with more victories in South America's major nation competition. Argentina has also been olympic champions twice (2008 and 2012). Currently the team is managed by former footballer Lionel Scaloni and captained by global icon Lionel Messi.
ARG.name: Argentine Football Association

ASM.description: AS Monaco is a historic French Championship club, founded in 1924. With eight Ligue 1 championship titles, ten national cups and two European Cup finals (Champions League 2004, Cup 1992), AS Monaco has one of the greatest track records in French football and a strong heritage. The famous diagonal jersey created by Princess Grace in 1960, the Stade Louis-II built on the Mediterranean Sea, the tradition of the beautiful game and the training (five French World Champions - T.Henry, D.Trezeguet, E.Petit, L.Thuram and K.Mbappé) - are the markers of a club with a unique situation, turned towards excellence. Cosmopolitan, in the image of the Principality of which it is an ambassador, AS Monaco relies on a brand known throughout the world and followed by a large community of more than 18,5 million on social networks.
ASM.name: AS Monaco

ASR.description: Formed as the result of a tri-team merger in 1927, AS Roma has been one of Italy’s more iconic competitors for more than 90 years. The club’s journey through the annals of its nations highest league has seen AS Roma capture 3 Serie A titles in addition to bringing the Coppa Italia home on 9 different occasions. A dominant force in its native land, AS Roma continues to push its organization to establish itself in the elite of European football.
ASR.name: AS Roma
